results.title: Marcos orders pilot testing of barrier-less system in expressways
results.description: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has ordered the pilot testing of a barrier-less system across all expressways before the end of 2026, the Department of Transportation (DOTr) said on Saturday.

results.title: Mumbai CCTV network to get AI upgrade with facial recognition, number plate detection
results.description: Hyderabad-based GVPR Engineers will implement the third phase of Mumbai’s CCTV project, introducing AI-based video analytics and advanced surveillance features by February 2027
